It’s like a mental reset button— a way to transition from “home mode” to “I’ve got this” mode. Plus, taking those extra minutes shows ** self-respect**. In a world that often rushes us, choosing to slow down and care for yourself is a powerful act. If it makes you feel prepared and grounded, * keep doing it*. Either way, it’s a beautiful way to start the day. 💡✨ Keep up the great habits!
